parts:
Hi,

I am working on a measurement invariance model. I was testing threshold invariance and had issues in freeing one threshold.

For sake of example, the variable in question is a 4-point likert scale (so, 3 thresholds); there are two groups in my dataset. If I constrain all three thresholds to equality across two groups, lavaan quickly converges. However, I should allow threshold 3 (t3) to vary across groups. If I set t3 to be non-invariance, either using c(NA,NA)*t3 or labels as c(var3t3g1,var3t3g2)*t3, I receive an error message and the model is not fit:


Error in { : task 8 failed - "missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed"


What could be causing this problem?

Thank you.
